name: Create Pull Request
description: Create a pull request in a GitHub repository. Supports title, body, base/head branches, draft mode, labels, assignees, and reviewers.

head.description: The branch containing your changes (e.g., 'feature-branch' or 'fork-owner:branch')

base.description: The branch you want to merge into (default: main)

draft.description: Create as a draft pull request

steps.name: Create the pull request via GitHub API

code.source:
const resp = $.steps.createPR.response || {};
return {
  prNumber: resp.number,
  title: resp.title,
  state: resp.state,
  draft: resp.draft || false,
  head: resp.head?.ref || $.input.head,
  base: resp.base?.ref || $.input.base || 'main',
  url: resp.html_url,
  diffUrl: resp.diff_url,
  created: !!resp.number,
  summary: resp.number
    ? 'Created PR #' + resp.number + ': ' + resp.title + ' (' + (resp.head?.ref || $.input.head) + ' -> ' + (resp.base?.ref || $.input.base) + ')'
    : 'Failed to create pull request'
};
